title: An equivariant coset retraction preserving every normal level
statement: For every group G and subgroup H ≤ G, there is a function a : G → H such that a(h)=h for h∈H, a(hg)=h a(g) for h∈H and g∈G, and, simultaneously for every normal subgroup K of G contained in H, every g∈G and u∈K satisfy a(g)⁻¹a(gu)∈K, where elements of H are regarded as elements of G. Neither finite index nor normality of H is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ {G : Type} [Group G] (H : Subgroup G), ∃ a : G → H, (∀ h : H, a (h : G) = h) ∧ (∀ (h : H) (g : G), a ((h : G) * g) = h * a g) ∧ (∀ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal → K ≤ H → ∀ g u : G, u ∈ K → (a g : G)⁻¹ * (a (g * u) : G) ∈ K)
